_note: Phase 2c (owner decision D4): the GST portal's HSN / SAC master, vendored byte-for-byte. hsnSac.json is generated from it by normalise.ts (whitespace only — see the comment there); hsnMaster.test.ts checks the SHA-256 below and that the JSON equals the workbook. The file carries codes and descriptions only — no GST rates. No licence or terms statement is published with it; it is government reference data offered for download on the GST portal's tutorial site, cited here with its source. To update: download the file again, replace HSN_SAC.xlsx, update sha256 / lastModified / fetched below, then run `TOTAL_HSN_WRITE=1 npx vitest run src/shared/gst/hsnMaster` and review the diff of hsnSac.json.
